plan.project: Family Budget Application - Remove Shared/Personal Functionality
plan.goal: Complete removal of shared/personal distinction from reference modules (справочники)

overview.summary: The Family Budget application currently supports both shared (user_id = NULL) and personal (user_id = specific user) reference data. This plan outlines the systematic removal of this distinction, making all reference data strictly personal to each user. This will simplify the permission model, reduce code complexity, and improve data isolation.

impact.risk: Existing shared records (user_id = NULL) need migration strategy
impact.benefit: Simplified permission model - users only see their own data
Reduced code complexity by removing shared/personal branching logic

step.description: Create complete database backup before starting migration

commands.command: docker exec budget-postgres pg_dump -U budget budgetdb > backup_before_sharing_removal_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).sql

step.description: Identify all records with user_id = NULL that need migration

sql_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_d_period WHERE user_id IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_d_financial_center WHERE user_id IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_d_cost_center WHERE user_id IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_d_nomenclature WHERE user_id IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_d_article WHERE user_id IS NULL;

step.title: Create Data Migration Strategy
step.description: Decide how to handle existing NULL user_id records: 1. Option A: Assign to first admin user 2. Option B: Duplicate records for all existing users 3. Option C: Create default records for each user
step.recommended_strategy: Option A - Assign to first admin user for simplicity

step.description: Migrate existing NULL user_id records to specific users

step.description: Make user_id NOT NULL and remove shared-related fields

step.description: Execute the migration scripts
